#379 fix r3.summary:
Round 3 is amended into one commit, e946bf53, on 8f7d98aa in /tmp/wt-379. Nothing was pushed. Each item was reproduced on 7b0207bb in a detached worktree first. (1) Blocking logout text. Behaviour is unchanged; I measured it per shape in live rpc runs for anthropic and openai-codex. A logout during the backoff: the retry sends nothing and ends auto_retry_end(False,1) with 'The auth.json entry for

is an OAuth login that gave no key ... remove the entry'. The next turn uses the models.json key, or else the env key. A logout while the failing refresh is under way: the retry already uses that next key (end True,1). With no next key, nothing is sent and the retry ends with the adapter error ('No API key for provider: anthropic' / 'No OAuth token for openai-codex'). Corrected per shape: CHANGELOG, both guides and their bundled copies, ADR-0251 12.2 and 12.5 and a new 12.6, the decisions README row, and the auth_storage/model_registry docstrings. The stale 'remove the entry' advice is not a one-line fix, so it is left as a follow-up. (2) A malformed-gzip non-2xx answer now keeps its status. _helpers.StatusBeforeBody is an httpx response event hook that sees the status before the body is read, plus answer(client.post(...)). It is used at the codex refresh, anthropic _post_json, and the copilot refresh, device-code request and poll. A 2xx that cannot be decoded still raises as before. Live: gz502 then 200 is retried to success for all three providers, and the codex text is pi's '(502): Bad Gateway'. (3) The retry decision is now the harness's own record. _SetupFailure is set when the setup error message is built, re-pointed at the message the message_end hooks leave, and cleared when the next attempt starts. _is_retryable_error and the overflow recovery read the record, never the message's text or type. Live with a real -e JSON round-trip extension: the 401 naming 502 now ends (False,1), and a drop is retried to success. (4) WriteError and CloseError rows added. (5) Wording nits fixed. V7 and V24 rows added.

findings.title: Truncated refusal body becomes retryable
findings.detail: Category 1. Expired stored openai-codex OAuth creds; token endpoint answers 'HTTP/1.1 401' with Content-Length: 100 and body '{' then EOF (same for 501). httpx raises RemoteProtocolError, which is classified as transient transport, so the already-received terminal status is lost and the refused refresh is retried; the next 200 token response succeeds and a model request is sent. StatusBeforeBody.answer (packages/aelix-ai/src/aelix_ai/oauth/_helpers.py:270) preserves status only for DecodingError.
findings.evidence: Script probes/http_body.py; cmd: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/379-work/r3cross/uv-cache uv run --no-sync python .../probes/http_body.py. Output: INPUT status=401 body=truncated; token_hits=[(401, 'truncated'), (200, 'json')]; starts=[1]; ends=[(True, 1)]; model_keys=['refreshed-fake']; raised=False. Same for status=501. Codex notes sockets were blocked, so HTTP was replayed through httpx/httpcore's real parser from local response files.

findings.title: CHANGELOG says any undecodable 5xx is retried; 501 is not
findings.detail: Category 2. CHANGELOG.md:304 says a 5xx whose body cannot be read keeps its status and is retried too. For HTTP 501 with Content-Encoding: gzip and body 'not-gzip', the status is kept but the error is not retried (501 is not in the transient set). The wording is broader than the 429/500/502/503/504/520/524 behavior.
findings.evidence: probes/http_body.py: INPUT status=501 body=gzip; token_hits=[(501, 'gzip')]; starts=[]; ends=[]; model_keys=[]; raised=True; CHANGELOG_CLAIM_PRESENT True
